notes:
I can't give you the Jeremiah 3 notes yet, because I wasn't able to read any of the sources.

I tried to fetch six verse-by-verse commentaries at once: Enduring Word, Precept Austin, and Ellicott, Gill, the Pulpit Commentary and Matthew Henry on Bible Hub. The fetch ran, but my code to read the results crashed. Before I could fix it, I hit my limit on tool calls for this turn. So I never saw any of the commentary text.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and to give a URL for every point. Writing notes from memory would break both rules, so I've left them out completely.

If you send the request again (even just "continue"), I'll start over:

1. **Traditional reading:** read Jeremiah 3 in each commentary above and pull out what they say verse by verse.
2. **Protestant differences:** search the tradition sites for passages likely to show real differences. Examples are the divorce law in v. 1 and Deuteronomy 24; Israel being "more righteous" than Judah in v. 11; the ark being forgotten in v. 16; and the nations gathering at Jerusalem in vv. 17–18, which raises the question of Israel and the church.
3. **Other views:** check the NET Bible notes and Bible Odyssey for modern scholarship, and New Advent, Catholic.com and OCA for Catholic and Orthodox readings. I'll also look for popular modern teaching that is debated, where the sites discuss it.

Each point will be written up as "v. X: …" with its URL, and anything I can't find will be left out.
